presentation.label: MIDI EXPRESSION
presentation.summary: Pitch bend, aftertouch and the mod wheel from MIDI IN play a MIDI track's synth and the Digitakt's own audio tracks, with each track's own settings on a second TRIG page.
presentation.overview: Stock, the Digitakt passes the notes of an external keyboard through to the synth a MIDI track plays, but drops pitch bend, aftertouch and the mod wheel. With SETTINGS > PB THRU, AT THRU and MW THRU ticked, those messages follow the notes: on the AUTO CHANNEL to the active track, and on a track's own TRACK CHANNEL to that track. A MIDI track adds them to its own PB, AT and MW (its knob, parameter locks and LFO), within the MIDI limits, on its CHAN out of MIDI OUT. An audio track bends its TUNE and moves two parameters of its choice. Each track's settings are on the TRIG page's second page: tap TRIG on the TRIG page. Selecting another track gives the previous one its own values back. For live playing: nothing is recorded into the sequencer. Unticked, MIDI handling is stock.
highlights: Play a synth through a MIDI track with pitch bend, aftertouch and the mod wheel.
Audio tracks: bend the pitch by up to 12 semitones, and send the wheel and aftertouch to filter, amp, SRC or LFO parameters.
Each track's own settings on a second TRIG page: bend range and routes for audio tracks; on/off and the wheel or pressure as any CC for MIDI tracks.
Adds to the track's LFO and parameter locks instead of fighting them, within the MIDI limits.
Follows the stock AUTO CHANNEL and TRACK CHANNEL routing of the notes; leaving a track restores its own values.
usage: Connect a keyboard to MIDI IN on the AUTO CHANNEL and a synth to MIDI OUT.
Tick PB THRU, AT THRU and MW THRU in SETTINGS.
Select a track, open its TRIG page and tap TRIG again: set the bend range and the wheel and aftertouch routes (audio) or what passes and on which CC (MIDI) with knobs A-E.
Play: bends, pressure and the wheel reach the track.

access.location: SETTINGS > PB THRU, AT THRU, MW THRU; the TRIG page's second page (tap TRIG on the TRIG page)
steps: Use a build containing MIDI Expression for the original Digitakt on OS 1.54.
Press SETTINGS and go down to PB THRU, AT THRU and MW THRU, below SYSTEM. YES ticks or unticks a row.

Select a track, press TRIG for its TRIG page, then tap TRIG again: the EXPRESSION page. Knobs A-E set its five rows; UP/DOWN or LEVEL move the cursor, LEFT/RIGHT change, YES toggles. TRIG or NO goes back.

controls.name: PB THRU
controls.doc: SETTINGS. Ticked: pitch bend from MIDI IN reaches the tracks the notes would play. Unticked: dropped, as stock, and every track gets its own value back. Unticked at power-on; not saved.

controls.name: AT THRU
controls.doc: SETTINGS. Ticked: channel aftertouch, routed like PB THRU. Poly aftertouch is not passed.

controls.name: MW THRU
controls.doc: SETTINGS. Ticked, with PORT CONFIG > RECEIVE CC/NRPN ticked: the mod wheel (CC 1), routed like PB THRU, after the stock control-change handling.

controls.name: BEND RANGE
controls.doc: Audio track, knob A: OFF, 1-12 semitones: how far a full bend moves the track's TUNE, within TUNE's own +-24. Default: 2 ST.

controls.name: MW DEST
controls.doc: Audio track, knob B: OFF or the parameter the wheel moves (SRC, FLTR, AMP or LFO amounts). Default: OFF.

controls.name: MW AMOUNT
controls.doc: Audio track, knob C: -64 to +64, how far a full wheel moves MW DEST, in the stock LFO's scale. Default: +32.

controls.name: AT DEST
controls.doc: Audio track, knob D: OFF or the parameter aftertouch moves. Default: OFF.

controls.name: AT AMOUNT
controls.doc: Audio track, knob E: -64 to +64, how far full pressure moves AT DEST. Default: +32.

controls.name: PITCH BEND / AFTERTOUCH / MOD WHEEL
controls.doc: MIDI track, knobs A-C: whether this track passes each one on to its synth. Default: ON.

controls.name: MW AS
controls.doc: MIDI track, knob D: CC 1 adds the wheel to the track's own MW; CC 2-119 sends the wheel alone on that CC (0 when you leave the track). Default: CC 1 (MW).

controls.name: AT AS
controls.doc: MIDI track, knob E: channel aftertouch added to the track's own AT, or the pressure alone on CC 1-119. Default: AFTERTCH.

limitations: Not saved: the THRU rows start unticked and every track's settings start at their defaults at every power-on.
Sends to DIN MIDI OUT only, not USB: the stock USB sender is not safe to call from the MIDI input task.
Not recorded: the sequencer never sees the live values.
A bend can reach the synth a few milliseconds before the note played with it.
Digi Perform opens its own page with the same gesture (TRIG again on the TRIG page): the two are not built together.

claims: ui:TRIG page:second page, TRIG pressed again

load.conditions: Measure under a flood of notes, CC, pitch bend, aftertouch and clock at the wire rate.

tests.summary: Host unit tests (476 checks): sums with the track's own PB/AT/MW, MIDI limits, take-over, release on track change, priority and routing. Emulator (digiemu): pass-through on the notes' route from the auto channel and TRACK CHANNEL; unticked identical to stock; stock CC handling unchanged; beside FX Track and CC Recall. Hardware not yet tested. 0.3: in the emulator, the render's parameter words show TUNE +-2 semitones and an aftertouch route on L1 depth, released on track change; links beside Digi Matrix and Digi Poly.
